Moreover, we see further support in [E15] and [E16], where the compounded sales growth over the last 3 and 12 months respectively is 101% and 222%. These figures indicate rapid and accelerating growth, which is a strong indicator of future profitability. Given that Simplex Realty Ltd has also demonstrated robust profit growth in recent years as evidenced by [E52] and [E54], it suggests that the company's earnings are on an upward trajectory. Despite this concession, the overall evidence points towards an underappreciated business with strong future prospects.
